comparison.objective: Hold a self-closing gate while pushing a parcel through to a conveyor; candidate mates a jig to a rail and transfers a bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests simultaneous gate restraint and planar parcel pushing through an opening. Candidate tests precise coaxial/parallel support mating and controlled sliding of an internally mobile assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires no gate–parcel contact, valid gateway passage, parcel delivery, gate closure, and arm return. Candidate requires complete transfer with no interface gap or lost ball and a stable release.
comparison.reason: Generic bimanual coordination is shared, but the record does not exercise continuous race support or rolling-element containment.
